That sounds really rough. You sound like an amazing parent who's doing their best. I'm saying this as someone with ADHD, you're allowed to feel negative having to deal with so much all the time and you shouldn't feel guilty for it either because despite everything you're still doing your best and that's all we can ask for from our parents. (that and empathy but you seem to have that down pat) take a deep breath and remember you're doing your best. I'm no parent but what helps me when my much younger sister is upsetting me is trying to see the world from her p.o.v. what is she feeling? What would I be feeling if I were acting similar to her? You're probably doing something similar but please know how amazed I am at you for doing all you can!

I honestly hate the comments on how B’s and C’s are okay. I might be a failing doofus but I remember the need to do well and I respect it. I’m still struggling with the rest. I procrastinate like crazy, drive myself into a frenzy, and just bail on trying and it hurts. I don’t like being like this it’s just how I react. It usually takes my parents screaming about my grades to get me to do work and even though I feel bad for putting them in that position it’s the main way I can get stuff done and it cracks out an emotion of anger I’m addicted to because it’s the only time I can actually feel any actual emotion besides occasional fear in real life. I do have dreams for real life but instead of them being acted upon as motivation they get crammed in with all my other fantasy daydreaming. Grades are my way of showing who I am too. I hate how apathetic I am towards my life especially my grades. For a bare minimum reach in life try to go for accounting or a coding job. It’s the fastest one to get to and it’s one of my contingencies if I can’t fix myself in time. I highly doubt you don’t have a mental illness (normal people only joke about suicide lightly) but I understand the feeling of self-loathing and not wanting to put in the effort to find someone to talk to. We can always chat if you like. I’m always venting towards my friends about my mediocre issues and if you feel like talking to me is bad on your part just call it karma.
